$$

feedback.problem:
Calculate the number of terms in the following arithmetic series. 

$$
5.5+6+6.5+...=77.5
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
To solve this problem, we use the formula for the sum of an arithmetic series:

$$
{S}_{N}=\frac{N}{2}(2{a}_{1}+(N-1)d)
$$

We have been given the sum ${S}_{N}=77.5,$ and the first term ${a}_{1}=5.5.$ Our goal is to find $N,$ the number of terms.

The common difference $d$ can be found, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}d & ={a}_{2}-{a}_{1} \\  & =6-5.5 \\  & =0.5\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting into the formula for ${S}_{N}$ gives

$$
\begin{aligned}{S}_{N} & =\frac{N}{2}(2{a}_{1}+(N-1)d) \\ 77.5 & =\frac{N}{2}(2(5.5)+(N-1)(0.5)) \\ 155 & =N(11+0.5N-0.5) \\ 155 & =N(10.5+0.5N) \\ 155 & =10.5N+0.5{N}^{2} \\ 0.5{N}^{2}+10.5N-155 & =0\end{aligned}
$$

For the equation above, the quadratic formula gives:

$$
\begin{aligned}N & =\frac{-10.5\pm \sqrt{(-10.5)^{2}-4\cdot 0.5\cdot (-155)}}{2\cdot 0.5} \\  & =\frac{-10.5\pm 20.5}{1}\end{aligned}
$$

Hence, $N=10$ or $N=-31.$ We disregard the negative solution since $N$ must be positive.

Therefore, our series has $N=10$ terms.
